description: This file defines classes and structures related to database connection and operations, including DatabaseConnection, DatabaseTable, DatabaseRow, and DatabaseColumnEntry. It provides interfaces for connecting to a database, executing queries, and managing query results within a plugin namespace.

classes.name: DatabaseTable
classes.description: Represents a database table, containing rows and columns, provides methods to add and access rows and columns.

classes.name: DatabaseRow
classes.description: Represents a row in a database table, containing multiple columns.

classes.name: DatabaseColumnEntry
classes.description: Represents a column entry in a database row, encapsulating a column name and its value.

classes.name: DatabaseConnection
classes.description: Manages database connection lifecycle, executes queries, and retrieves results, ensuring thread safety with mutex.

methods.name: DatabaseConnection()
methods.description: Constructor for DatabaseConnection, initializes member variables.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the specified database.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a SQL query without expecting results.

methods.name: ExecAndGetModified
methods.description: Executes a query and returns the number of rows modified.

methods.name: ExecAndGetResults
methods.description: Executes a query and fills the provided DatabaseTable with results.

methods.name: GetDatabaseName
methods.description: Returns the name of the connected database.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if the connection to the database is active.
